captureRevisions.reason: Recaptured after the user fixed Arabic compact-mode trailing text alignment.
captureRevisions.unaffectedWidgetStyles: Home captures use medium/large list widgets with explicit 20-point artwork. Lock captures use LockScreenConfigurationProvider and showProgress:false, retaining 20-point circular artwork. The newer single-widget and progress-widget icon sizing changes do not affect these captured styles.

imageProcessing: None. Original simulator PNG bytes; phone frame applied by website CSS.
lockScreenCaptureMethod: Native Lock Screen widgets shown through Notification Center, outside the editor.

visualNotes.note: The native editor navigation heading uses an ellipsis at this device width. Event content is visible; application UI was not changed.
